q: "Build a house in ___. Sleep comfortably. Enjoy your food. Lastly, spend money like a rich man…."
explanation: every는 반드시 단수명사와 함께 쓰이므로 every city가 알맞다. 원문: "'Build a house in every city. Sleep comfortably. Enjoy your food. Lastly, spend money like a rich man….'"

q: Before he could explain ___, he passed away.
explanation: explain oneself(심중을 털어놓다)에서 목적어로 쓰인 재귀대명사는 생략할 수 없으므로 himself가 쓰인다. 원문: "Before he could explain himself, he passed away."

q: After his death, the two sons ___ of the father's wealth and settled in different cities.
explanation: 주어 the two sons(복수)와 소유격이 일치해야 하므로 their share가 쓰인다. 원문: "After his death, the two sons took their share of the father's wealth and settled in different cities."

q: Five years passed. Puru, who ___ his father's words carefully, had no money left.
explanation: 과거의 특정 시점(아버지가 돌아가신 후)부터 그 이전 시점까지 계속 진행되고 있었던 일을 나타내는 과거완료진행(had been+-ing)이다. 원문: "Five years passed. Puru, who had been following his father's words carefully, had no money left."

q: But his brother was ___ than ever.
explanation: '비교급+than ever'는 '그 어느 때보다 더 ~한'이라는 뜻으로, rich의 비교급 richer가 쓰인다. 원문: "But his brother was richer than ever."

q: Puru was puzzled about where he ___ wrong, so he visited Puneet to find out.
explanation: 'had+과거분사' 형태의 과거완료시제로, 방문한 시점(과거)보다 이전에 일어난 일을 나타낸다. 원문: "Puru was puzzled about where he had gone wrong, so he visited Puneet to find out."
'두 팔을 벌리고 (반갑게)'라는 뜻의 관용 표현은 with open arms이다. 원문: "Puneet welcomed Puru with open arms."

q: That night, when the brothers sat down to chat after dinner, Puru asked the question ___ on his mind for days.
explanation: 선행사 the question을 받는 주격 관계대명사 that과, 질문한 시점보다 더 이전부터 있었던 일을 나타내는 과거완료(had been)가 함께 쓰였다. 원문: "That night, when the brothers sat down to chat after dinner, Puru asked the question that had been on his mind for days."

q: "___ our father's advice that I followed, but I am not happy.
explanation: 'It was ~ that ...' 강조 구문으로 our father's advice를 강조하고 있다. 원문: "'It was our father's advice that I followed, but I am not happy."

q: I ___ a house in every city.
explanation: 이야기 전체가 과거시제로 서술되므로 build의 불규칙 과거형 built가 쓰인다. 원문: "I built a house in every city."
